svg.title: The life-crm framework, as a notebook sketch
svg.desc: Hand-drawn map: Engine builds the Repo and the Storage sheet; Storage feeds the Website and talks both ways with the Interface; the Human chats with the Interface, sees the Website and can open the sheet; Connectors send facts to Engine and Interface. A privacy line across the top, with Cloudflare login as the gate.
